_comment: DT-001 labelled corpus (PROJ-039 AC-002 / MVP-11). 10 pairs: each query is semantically related to its target brief but the query phrase does not appear verbatim anywhere in the brief corpus (grep-baseline = 0, enforced by tests/proj039/test_recall_harness.py). Label quality guarded by ST-003.

pairs.brief: Rotate the expiring TLS certificate for the Qdrant ingress endpoint at qdrant.agenticflows.co.uk and verify the new chain is served on port 443. Confirm curl validates without --insecure and update the runbook with the rotation date.
pairs.query: renew the soon-to-lapse https cert on the vector database host

pairs.brief: Migrate the legacy tasking records from the agentsonly cluster into the unified cloud collection, preserving the audit trail for every session: dispatch timestamp, response content, and status-transition events must all remain retrievable after the move.
pairs.query: move the old coordination data into the new datastore without losing history

pairs.brief: Add a Kubernetes CronJob that snapshots the vector store every night at 02:00 and prunes snapshots older than seven days. Persist snapshots to the piraeus-datastore PVC and alert on two consecutive failures.
pairs.query: schedule automatic backups with a one week retention window

pairs.brief: Implement exponential backoff with jitter for the Ollama embedding client so a transient timeout or connection reset does not fail the session hook. Cap total retry time at sixty seconds and log each attempt.
pairs.query: make the embedding calls resilient to flaky network errors

pairs.brief: Build a Grafana dashboard showing per-agent token spend by model over the trailing thirty days, broken down by input, output, and cache-read buckets, sourced from the sessions collection rollups.
pairs.query: visualise llm cost and usage for each teammate

pairs.brief: Harden the bastion host freyr: disable password SSH logins, enforce key-only authentication, remove unused open ports from iptables, and document the surviving rules in the network inventory.
pairs.query: lock down remote access on the jump server

pairs.brief: Build a FastAPI endpoint that accepts an inventory photo upload, forwards it to the photo processor, and returns the catalogue entry that was created, including thumbnail URL and detected attributes.
pairs.query: api route for ingesting product pictures into the catalogue

pairs.brief: Reconcile the Cloudflare zone against the domain inventory and delete any stale A records still pointing at decommissioned hosts. Produce a before and after record listing for the audit log.
pairs.query: clean up dead dns entries left over from retired machines

pairs.brief: Profile the consolidation script and cut its wall-clock time by batching the Qdrant scroll requests and caching the gh pr view lookups. Target is under ninety seconds for a full pass.
pairs.query: speed up the slow merge job by reducing round trips

pairs.brief: Document the zero-trust bootstrap flow for newly provisioned clusters, covering how Flux obtains its deploy key, how SOPS age secrets are seeded, and which steps require operator presence.
pairs.query: explain how a fresh cluster authenticates itself at first boot
